about: GTA 6 trailer songs: GTA 6's first trailer turned Tom Petty's 1989 B-side 'Love Is a Long Road' into a streaming spike (Spotify to BBC Newsbeat: +36,979% vs the week before). Trailer 2 did it again with the Pointer Sisters; the launch trailer broke the pattern with a new Justice song. No music played. Factory Delta #5.
